lesson-intro.text: A space shuttle goes up on boosters and glides home on its wings. Watch it stack up, then light the engines.

body.text: The shuttle's body is a tall bullet. Draw the left side down from the nose.

body-2.text: Bring the right side down to match, and close it along the bottom.

nose-line.text: One curved line across the top marks off the nose.

window.text: Under it, the window is a small rounded shape lying flat.

wings.text: A wing sweeps out and down from each side. Then it curves back up to the body.

boosters.text: A booster stands on each wing: a tall tube with a pointed top. One line across each, near the top.

nozzles.text: Three nozzles sit under the shuttle, one in the middle and one each side. Each nozzle gets a line across it.

flames.text: A flame comes out of every nozzle, three pointed teardrops.

orange-parts.text: Color both boosters orange, and all three flames.

dark-parts.text: The wings are gray, and the nose and nozzles darker gray.

window-color.text: Color the window blue, and the middle of each flame yellow.

lesson-outro.text: That's a shuttle ready to fly. It's the wings that bring it back down.
